translation: Woe to those that deal in fraud

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ
translation: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure
But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due
Do they not think that they will be called to account
On a Mighty Day
A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds

arabic: كـَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٖ
translation: Nay! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin
And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is
(There is) a Register (fully) inscribed
Woe, that Day, to those that deny
Those that deny the Day of Judgment

arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner

arabic: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
translation: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients

arabic: كـَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
translation: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do

arabic: كـَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
translation: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled
Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell

arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false

arabic: كـَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
translation: Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin
And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is
(There is) a Register (fully) inscribed
To which bear witness those Nearest (to Allah)
Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss
On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things)
Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss
Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed

arabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكٞۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
translation: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations
With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim
A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to Allah

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
translation: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed
And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery)

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
translation: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting

arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
translation: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray
But they had not been sent as keepers over them

arabic: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ
translation: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers
On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things)

arabic: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
translation: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did
